A simply less process.
I HIGHLY recommend them.

The staff here are exceptional beyond words. Not just your "casual nice" but they are very empathetic, understanding, and patient. You know how you know when someone LOVES their job. That is nothing short of the vibe you'll get when you enter. They take it pets early so not to keep everyone waiting so if you happen to be on time or a little late (I was 15 min. late!) dont worry about it. They understand traffic happens. And they let you know how your furbaby did under the anesthesia. Mine cat is scared of everyone and they knew how to handle her so she wouldnt be so frightened. They also call as soon as your pet is ready to go home so dont rely solely on the 4pm pickup time. As soon as they are done they call you. And they are so cheap compared to all these vet offices I tried calling. They also do so much outreach stuff for strays that they're literally working every possible hour through the season. They could even say when they open up stray appointments again they took so many and its Aug. They deserve a lot of credit. I will only take my cats here. They even sent home my cats meds already dosed out in syringes (without needle) and decorated the meds bag. They even take special care with details, though that might not seem like much, its not about the bag clearly, it shows in everything they do which is important when you are handing your baby over into another person's care.
Have taken 4 cats there over the last few years. They are excellent and helping the community so much.

Spay & neuter service with a voucher. Still paid over a hundred & bought 2 collars, asked for help putting them on. They replied no. I can do when I get them home. Didn’t use the dumb collars at all. A wasted 30 bucks. Everything else was fine

I cannot say enough good things about this clinic.  I TNR feral cats and honestly don't know what I would do with them.  Their staff is the best I have encountered.  Their surgical skills are excellent as I have not experienced any problems with any of the cats I bring there.  They offer some services that other clinics don't and they do it at a very reasonable price.  Even though I deal with feral cats I highly recommend that everyone trust this clinic with their beloved pets as well.

Had a great experience here getting my 90 lb house hippo neutered. The online registration process was thorough and efficient, and so we're the drop-off and pick up. The staff were friendly and professional,  and they took great care of my baby. The price is unbeatable and we went home with all needed medications and thorough post-op instructions. 12/10 would recommend 👍
I've taken 3 pets there over the years. I'm always extremely happy with the service and the value. I will always tell people about altered trails and return myself.
I took my kitten to be spayed so she wouldn't have kittens. She's only 3 months old, and they treated her very well and quickly. Thank you.

Although they no longer have a Rescue Partner Program, which is extremely beneficial for self funded rescues like ours, we appreciate their hard work,  dedication,  friendly staff and amazing doctors for giving back to the community at a much lower cost than your friendly neighborhood veterinarian.

Recommended! Low cost does not mean low service. The staff are all completely wonderful. Friendly and helpful with every question. Whether you're a TNR trapper or bringing in your favorite fur baby to get fixed, you can feel secure in knowing Altered Tails cares about each and every cat or dog that come through their door.

TNR?
Once you have a spay / neuter appointment set, they offer live traps for you to use if you are trying to catch a feral cat. They give great educational advice and support if you are new to TNR. Stop by and speak to the great gals at the front desk.
Very friendly staff, very good at their jobs. Quick check in, loves the animals and very clear and friendly with questions and care.

Surprised and grateful for the excellent service and perfect surgery, from the moment we arrived we were treated with care and efficiency. My dog ​​was operated on within hours, and the surgery was so successful that she didn't even need pain medication.  She was completely recovered in just two days.  Many thanks to everyone at the clinic.
This place is not your fancy animal clinic but they get the job done at a more affordable rate.  If you are looking to spay or neuter your pet this is the place to go!

I was very worried about the cost and when I saw the bill I cried tears of joy. I feel blessed to have been able to take her here, and that there is a place as amazing as this is in practice. You guys are all doing AMAZING! THANK YOU!! 🥲 🩷

I highly recommend Altered Tails for pet spaying and neutering. As first-time dog pawrents, we were nervous about our pup’s first surgery, but the staff was incredibly patient and informative. They answered all our questions and explained everything clearly, from pre-op to recovery.

We opted for the pre-surgery bloodwork, and during that time, the staff noticed our pup was very excitable. They thoughtfully provided sedatives to help calm her before surgery, making the experience more comfortable and less stressful for her.

On the day of the surgery, we felt at ease leaving her in their care. When we called for an update, the team kindly reassured us that she did great and was recovering well. They notified us when she was ready to be picked up, and both drop-off and pick-up were straightforward. The discharge instructions were clear and easy to follow.

Affordable, safe, and stress-free, with optional add-on services too. Thank you, Altered Tails, for taking such great care of our fur baby!
